name: jontro-haat-ecommerce
description: JontroHaat is a full-stack e-commerce application with a responsive customer storefront and a protected administration dashboard. Customers can browse and review products, manage a cart, apply coupons, place orders, view order history, and chat with support in real time.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
